decisions.reason: Building directly on the firm's established automation and robotics knowledge, the firm can readily interpret early results and improve the product, so it is likely to keep it.
As a related extension of existing loading and automation systems, the firm has the absorptive capacity to learn from initial market feedback and continue developing it.

Because this dispensing machine is distant from the firm's core knowledge, the firm has limited ability to assimilate market feedback and improve it, making discontinuation likely despite the design award.
